verdict.rationale: Groq's billing FAQ documents first-party spend limits: users can set automated spending limits and receive budget alerts, a benefit unlocked when upgrading to a paid plan. That covers both caps and alerts, but the evidence is a single FAQ line with no detail on how the cap behaves. Missing for 10: documentation of enforcement behavior (whether requests are hard-stopped at the cap), configuration details such as thresholds and alert channels, clarity on free-tier availability, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can set spending caps or budget alerts so a runaway workload cannot generate an unbounded bill

citations.quote: Spend Limits: Set automated spending limits and receive budget alerts
Immediately after upgrading, you unlock several benefits: Higher Token Limits... Flex Service Tier... Batch Processing... Spend Limits
